name: Orca

requiredConfig.name: Orca Whirlpools client
requiredConfig.description: Needed for Whirlpool pool/position reads and prepare-only liquidity, fee, and reward actions.

readCapabilities.returns: Orca Whirlpool token mints, vaults, tick spacing, current tick/price, liquidity, fee tier, reward mints, and program id.
Wallet-owned Orca Whirlpool tokenized positions with range, liquidity, fee, and reward facts.
One Orca position by position mint, including range status, fees, rewards, and warning flags.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to increase liquidity in an existing Orca Whirlpool position or open a new ranged position.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews Whirlpool, position/range, token amount, slippage, and warning facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to decrease liquidity from an Orca Whirlpool position.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews position, range, liquidity amount or percent, token minimums, slippage, and warning facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to collect trading fees from one Orca Whirlpool position.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews position and fee facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to collect rewards from one Orca Whirlpool position.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews position and reward mint facts before wallet signing.

requiredUserInputs.name: whirlpoolAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Orca Whirlpool should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: positionMint
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Orca position mint should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: tokenAmount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What token amount should I add?

requiredUserInputs.name: tickRange
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What lower and upper ticks should the new position use?

requiredUserInputs.name: liquidityAmount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much liquidity should I remove, as a percent or exact liquidity amount?

requiredConnectorFacts: Position mint and range for position-specific actions
Claimable fees and rewards for collect actions
Wallet token balances and fee headroom
unsupportedRequests: Prepare Orca actions without a Whirlpool or position when required.
Claim fees or rewards without a position mint.
Open a new position without lower and upper ticks.
Use invalid tick ordering or ticks not aligned to the Whirlpool tick spacing.
Guarantee range profitability or that a range will remain active.
Use Orca legacy pools, vault products, or automated LP strategy management in v1.
Create delegated managers or recurring LP automation.
Claim the agent signed or submitted the Orca transaction.
actionPreparationNotes: Orca is first-class for Whirlpools. Read pool or position facts first, prepare only approval-bound actions, and refresh Whirlpool state at execution time.
riskNotes: Whirlpool liquidity can go out of range and has impermanent-loss exposure. Show pool, range, fee/reward, slippage, and warning facts before approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: Orca writes create prepared actions. The agent reviews and prepares; the user's wallet signs separately.

needsInputQuestions: Which Whirlpool address should I read?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Provide the Whirlpool address.
Read Orca Whirlpool positions for the connected wallet. The connector can read facts, but the wallet still controls approval.

requests.user: prepare increasing liquidity on this Orca position by 0.01 SOL. Do not sign.
requests.agentResponse: Prepared an Orca increase-liquidity review with position, range, token amount, and slippage facts. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: prepare removing 25 percent of this Orca position.
requests.agentResponse: Prepared an Orca decrease-liquidity review with position, range, liquidity percent, and slippage facts. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: claim Orca fees for this position
requests.agentResponse: Prepared an Orca fee-collection review for this position. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: claim Orca rewards for this position
requests.agentResponse: Prepared an Orca reward-collection review for this position. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: guarantee this Orca range will stay active
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because it cannot guarantee market movement or range safety.
The agent denied this because Orca first-class actions are cataloged for mainnet-beta only.

requests.user: move my Orca liquidity without wallet approval
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the connector cannot move funds without the user's wallet.

requests.user: use Orca while the connector is disabled
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because this connector is not enabled.

mirrorsCanonical.note: Mirrors Orca browser catalog support for first-class Whirlpool reads and prepared actions.
